hooks.command: H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}/tools/session-hook"; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$H.mjs" start; else bash "$H.sh" start; fi 2>/dev/null || true

H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}/tools/session-hook"; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$H.mjs" stop; else bash "$H.sh" stop; fi 2>/dev/null || true

H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}/tools/session-hook"; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$H.mjs" end; else bash "$H.sh" end; fi 2>/dev/null || true
